description.value: Bow & Stern is a family-owned, ocean-inspired seafood restaurant group founded in 2014 by the Smith family, with their signature fish and chips recipe at the heart of the menu. The Brentwood location, the newest of three BC restaurants, is situated inside The Amazing Brentwood shopping centre on the second floor. It offers dine-in table bookings, online pickup ordering, and group booking options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website contact page explicitly lists the Brentwood location at '4567 #2626 Lougheed Hwy, Burnaby BC' with phone (236)-455-6562, confirming OSM address and phone. The about page confirms the Brentwood location opened September 2024 and OSM check_date is 2024-09-27, supporting confirmed-open status. The website's /order-1 page shows an online pickup ordering system, confirming takeout; no cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Restaurant is on floor 2 of The Amazing Brentwood shopping mall (addr:floor=2, addr:unit=2626); cyclists should be aware it is an indoor mall location, not a street-level standalone building — bike parking would depend on mall provisions.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open seafood restaurant with a confirmed Brentwood/Burnaby location; OSM data and website are consistent. Suitable for inclusion in a cycling tourism directory as a food stop.

wow_evidence: family-owned, ocean-inspired seafood restaurant group founded in 2014... three BC restaurants
